work_item: B03 bounded exact single-variable quadratic equation solver through input and Core
source_snapshot_method: SHA-256 of the compact JSON file inventory in code-snapshot.json

initial_compile_failures.cause: Clippy identified a manually written integer ceiling division in the integer square-root initializer.
initial_compile_failures.correction: Used the standard integer div_ceil method; formatting, check, Clippy and build then passed.

implemented_route: apps/cli -> Engine::execute/execute_inner -> input::seal -> input::interpret -> input::structured_intent (no match) -> input::mathematics_intent -> Intent::QuadraticEquation -> math::solve_quadratic -> serialized QuadraticSolution artifact -> Core computed result
supported_behavior: Japanese 「二次方程式 left=right を解いて」 and English `solve-quadratic left=right` select one bounded explicit equality; malformed or multiple equalities remain unresolved.

The existing exact sparse-polynomial grammar reduces both sides to one normalized equation. Multiplication must be explicit; exactly one syntactically mentioned variable and normalized degree two with nonzero leading coefficient are required.
The result contains the normalized [a,b,c] coefficients, exact discriminant, root classification, exact real or complex roots, exact root sum and product, and operation count.
Rational real roots are verified by exact substitution. Irrational and complex forms are emitted as exact quadratic-formula radicals without decimal approximation.
Existing expression length, coefficient, term, degree and operation bounds remain in force; unsupported shapes produce typed errors.
known_limits: This follow-up covers bounded exact single-variable equations only; broader B03 mathematics and independent quality populations remain unverified.
Rational quadratic roots were observed through the normal CLI route; repeated, radical and complex roots were checked at the component layer.
Irrational and complex roots use exact formula forms and are not separately substituted through an algebraic-number evaluator.

acceptance.B03: UNVERIFIED; the follow-up ran 154 workspace tests and observed bounded linear/quadratic cases through normal CLI, but the broader independent structured/natural-language B03 observable remains open.

initial_tests_and_route.reason_not_executed: This slice did not run tests or a runtime route; verification was limited to formatting, compilation, lint, build and static diff checks.

normal_cli_observations.input: 一次方程式 2*x+1=0 を解いて
二次方程式 2*x^2-3*x+1=0 を解いて

component_observations: Repeated quadratic root x=-1 has multiplicity 2.
x^2=2 produces two exact radical forms retaining sqrt(8)/2.
x^2+1=0 produces two exact complex-conjugate forms retaining i*sqrt(4).
Malformed linear directive equalities, multi-variable linear equations, degree-two linear equations, and unsupported quadratic variable/degree shapes are rejected by input/component tests.
